_meta.viewer_consolidation: SinglePostView and Lightbox were superseded by ImageViewer with a thin ImagePage route adapter in 1.202.0. Historical rows retain their original source names; current behavioral coverage is in ui-regressions.py.
_meta.description: kura web UI duplication ledger — plan kura-web-componentization P1. Regenerate via scripts/devtools/dupe-audit.py (measurements are machine-derived; status/resolution are hand-edited and preserved across re-runs). rank = sites × lines × surface × coupling_weight.
_meta.lines_semantics: pattern-matched line count per candidate — reproducible lower-bound proxy for duplicated implementation size

candidates.notes: hardcoded DB-hue-derived map (categoryColor.ts) と server-driven TagDetail.categoryColor (/tags 系のみ) の二重 SoT。P4 で DB 駆動へ 一本化 (map は fallback に降格)。coupling med は SSR 供給路の追加込み。

グローバル key map が post/[id] / SinglePostView / Lightbox で 各自 svelte:window onkeydown 登録 (+ 各 input の局所 handler)。重なり合う key (arrows/e/t/x/Space) の優先順位が暗黙 → coupling high、plan の決定事項どおり rank に関わらず deferred/分割抽出候補。
candidates.resolution: high coupling; plan rev2 defers/splits — candidate for kura-web-nav-unification tranche. 重なり合う key (arrows/e/t/x/Space) の優先順位が post/[id]/SinglePostView/Lightbox の svelte:window onkeydown 各自登録に暗黙に埋まっており、nav 規約 (openPost/viewerUrl) と同時に設計しないと lossy になる。
